CLEANING FLAGS AND ANOMALIES:
ANOMALY — MinimumWage_byProvince (06_Labor) file contains 5 non-wage series for tobacco manufacturing (capacity utilization, gross output, value added, establishments): series_ids 506662887, 359239887, 359240387, 359240137, 359239147. These belong more naturally to id_industrial_production_utilization but are kept in id_wages_earnings per file assignment. Flagged for reclassification.
ANOMALY — CommercialBank_CreditDeposits contains 2 daily (P1D) monetary base series (477137297: Commercial Banks Demand Deposits at BI; 477137277: Currency Outside Commercial and Rural Banks) mixed with monthly banking data. These conceptually fit id_money_supply / id_central_bank but are categorized id_banking per file assignment.
ANOMALY — GDP_Quarterly file mixes expenditure-side components (household/govt consumption, GFCF, exports/imports) AND industry GVA breakdown in the same file. Expenditure series could fit id_gdp_by_expenditure but the file is dominated by industry GVA -> assigned id_gdp_gva_by_industries overall. The 08_NationalAccounts/GDP_byExpenditure file is the canonical expenditure file.
NEAR-DUPLICATE — CommercialBank_CreditDeposits has dual-source overlap for the same loan concepts from Bank Indonesia and OJK (Indonesia Financial Services Authority): working capital (230931302 BI vs 230931402 OJK), investment (389697937 BI vs 230932202 OJK), consumption (225695702 BI vs 230931602 OJK). Different series_ids so dedup is safe; downstream users should be aware.
NEAR-DUPLICATE — SharePriceIndex: IMF series (base 2010=100) and OECD series (base 2015=100) cover the same concept at overlapping frequencies. Both retained; source noted in descriptions.
NOTE — FDI_byOriginSector mixes BKPM investment realization data (by country of origin) with Bank Indonesia BPM6-standard FDI data (by sector). Methodologically different; subcategory labels distinguish them.
NOTE — ConsumerConfidence file has 3 city-level CCI series (Surabaya, Palembang, Banjarmasin) mixed with national sub-indices and household expenditure allocation breakdowns by income bracket. Subcategorized accordingly.
NOTE — LoansByTypeOfUse (only 3 series) and CommercialBank_CreditDeposits both cover loan breakdowns at the bank level; both assigned id_banking. LoansByTypeOfUse covers the third-party lending universe.
NOTE — DepositLendingRates includes one daily BI Deposit Facility Rate (P1D) alongside monthly IMF deposit/lending rates. Frequency mismatch within the file is as-is from source.
